setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (2 reviews): Described as an exceptional version in a rowdy, rocking first set; Named a first-set highlight, along with the Let It Grow into Goin' Down the Road closer [7][11]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Called the real standout, a hot version from a year of strong ones, and leading into Goin' Down the Road; Rated top-tier, with a great Phil bass intro; the Goin' Down the Road ending jam resembles a Cold Rain and Snow reprise [7][15]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Praises the long stretch of music inside Playin', with room for spacey, stand-alone interludes beyond mere transitions; Second-set Playin' sandwich includes a section the reviewer says is now called the Orange Tango Jam [10][16]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Recalls the reverb on Jerry's guitar during Candyman [16]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Eleven minutes of Playing led to the Wheel, whose outro jam seemed headed for Dancing but held off until later [15]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): The jam after Samson works as an intro to Comes A Time, outside the usual Playin' jam [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer counts this Eyes among personal favorites, and says the jam leading into it is also excellent [6]

## The recordings

- **gd76-09-28.sbd.vernon.14355.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 158 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard matrix release sounds jangly, jarring and unpleasant to this reviewer [14]
- **gd76-09-28.aud.vernon.14356.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 4.27/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds poor to this listener, who wants it cleaned up and reposted; Audience tape is decent and captures Phil's high thumped bass notes and harmonics well; Audio is muddy but enjoyable for the era, rated around three stars [6][7][8][11][12]
- **gd1976-09-28.set2.aud.unknown.andrewf.100071.flac16**: audience recording; 12 songs; 79 min [3]
- **gd1976-09-28.sbd.vernon.10512.shnf**: soundboard; 1 songs; 5 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show; later saw them at Colgate, then Buffalo, and Jerry's own band at Brockport [9]
- Suggests the July Orpheum run for similar work inside Playin' [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-09-28.sbd.vernon.14355.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard source of unknown lineage, transferred to SHN, patched with an unknown audience tape by Matt Vernon, processed in Cool Edit [1]
- **gd76-09-28.aud.vernon.14356.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dale Shepherd; source: Audience Recording [2]
- **gd1976-09-28.set2.aud.unknown.andrewf.100071.flac16**: transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD of unknown lineage [3]
- **gd1976-09-28.sbd.vernon.10512.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD > MR > ? > CDR [4]
